review_reference: The services as deployed now, after backend release backend-41191658905-1-12d98e3f095d7031 (D-Eminence/hid-system#136 at 82f52b9). That release rebuilt and deployed every service at 82f52b9, because the runtime assessment it updates (CVE-2026-84243) is a build input, so every service pins to 82f52b9. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins: ehr-api's document upload link now carries the checksum and declared-sha256 as signed headers, which this frontend already sends from requiredHeaders (health#60), so uploads can complete; ocr-api publishes validated OCR evidence by default. gateway, lab-api, pharmacy-api, outreach-api, support-api and notification-api have no code change since 61fb36b. Nothing else this frontend calls changed shape. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-10-31 ("approve re-pin" and "Approve both", for re-pinning the website after the upload fix and OCR publishing release).
